show.description: Game of Guns follows Diya, an innocent nurse sold into human trafficking, whose life changes when dangerous arms dealer Armaan Shah rescues her. As love grows between them, they become trapped in a deadly world of obsession, betrayal, mafia wars, and revenge. While enemies target their love and unborn child, Armaan and Diya fight together to survive, protect their family, and defeat the darkness surrounding them. Watch now.
